mode.label: Mode
mode.autoBadgeTitle: The agent runs commands, edits files and browses the web without asking. Change the mode to go back to asking.
mode.autoConfirm: {agent} will run commands, change or delete files and use the web without asking you first. Only turn this on for projects where that is safe. You can switch back at any time; it applies from your next message.
mode.autoGuardClaude: Some actions still ask first, even here: sensitive files, deleting or moving files, installing software, downloading from the internet, git push, and anything outside the project folder. You can change that in the project settings.

friendly.acceptEdits: Change files automatically (still ask before running commands)

versions.notRepoDev: Not a git repository. Enable auto-commit for the project (git init) to use versions.
versions.autoWhere: FlowState saves a version automatically after each finished request, on its own line of work called "{name}", so your other work stays untouched.
versions.autoWhereDev: Auto-commits go to branch {name} (created on demand; secrets such as .env are never committed).
versions.emptyText: Versions appear here after the agent finishes a request, or when you save one.

versions.undone: Undone: back to how it was before.
versions.tryIdea: Try an idea in a new branch
versions.ideaHint: An idea is a separate line of work. Changes you make there do not touch your main work until you merge them.
versions.invalidName: That name cannot be used. Avoid spaces, "..", "~", "^", ":" and a leading "-".
versions.exists: A branch with that name already exists.
versions.notMerged: This idea has work that is not in your current work yet, so it cannot be deleted.
versions.switchedSaved: Switched to "{name}". Your unsaved work was saved first on the previous line.
versions.deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Everything in it is already part of your current work. This cannot be undone.
versions.mergeUpToDate: Nothing to merge: "{into}" already has everything from "{from}".

versions.mergeFast: It is a straight update; no mixing is needed.
versions.mergeConflicts: Conflict expected: both sides changed the same parts of {count} files. The merge would be cancelled and nothing would change.
versions.mergeNoPredict: Your Git version cannot predict conflicts; if one happens, the merge is cancelled automatically.
versions.mergeAborted: The merge was cancelled because of conflicts. Nothing changed in your files. Conflicting files: {files}
versions.safetyNote: Unsaved work was saved first as {tag}.

setup.title: Set up FlowState
setup.leaveText: You can run the setup again any time from Settings. Your choices so far are saved.
setup.welcomeText: FlowState is a friendly place to ask an AI helper to work on your files: spreadsheets, web pages, data and research. It keeps everything in one folder, remembers what happened and lets you undo changes. A few quick questions and you are ready.
setup.modeText: Pick the view that fits you. You can switch any time from the title bar or Settings.
setup.lookText: Choose how FlowState looks. It changes right away.
setup.helpersText: FlowState works with AI helpers that run on your PC. You need at least one signed in, but you can also sign in later.

helpers.claude: Made by Anthropic. The most complete helper.
helpers.opencode: Open source. Works with many providers, including DeepSeek.

setup.helpersReady: At least one helper is signed in. You are good to go.
setup.helpersLater: No helper is signed in yet. You can continue and sign in later from Settings.
setup.toolsText: These small programs help FlowState do its job. Install the ones you are missing, or do it later.

tools.git: Keeps a safe history of changes so you can always go back.
tools.python: Needed for Excel, data and dashboard work.

extras.usageText: FlowState shows how much of your plan you have used, right in the title bar. There is nothing to set up.
extras.skip: You can skip this: it is optional.

setup.storageText: Each project lives in its own folder, and new projects are created in a default folder for you.

storage.inside: Inside every project there is a hidden .flowstate folder. Your settings, history and progress are kept there, so they travel with the folder if you move or share it.

setup.doneText: Everything is ready. Let us create your first project: just tell us what you need help with.
